review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. Conditional acceptance criteria do not authorize choosing a default. The supplied complete implementation-owner evidence supports the message-formatting, normalization, readonly snapshot, inheritance, and fetch-option-filtering scope. Existing generic forwarding and declaration consumers require inspection, not mandatory edits; build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. The empty team catalog does not invalidate an intentional decision-stage stop because later reviewer, capability, and assignment prerequisites are not reached. Gold and preview release-input fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decision input, prompts, model, sampling, policy, and budgets. The source-manifest digest is separately scoped from the release-input source fingerprint. Historical project reuse is not treated as a candidate run or as new human confirmation. This review relies on the supplied Service-bound digests and evidence; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or infer test success.
